verdict.rationale: Devin has a public API (devin-docs-8) and supports creating sessions on behalf of organization users (devin-docs-9). Nothing in the evidence describes issuing API keys or tokens restricted by scope, permissions, or least privilege. The CLI's MCP tool-permission system (devin-docs-13) governs which tools the agent may use, not the scoping of API credentials, so it does not count toward this story.
